data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a strengthening of $9.135 million in prior year reserves, primarily driven by adverse claims development on the 2016 underwriting year. This is consistent with the 2016 year of account closing with a loss of $4.164 million. The adverse development is linked to the impacts of natural catastrophe events, specifically Hurricanes Harvey and Irma from 2017, which affected the 2016 and 2017 years of account, and Hurricanes Michael and Florence from 2018, which impacted the 2017 and 2018 years of account.
raw_causal_phrases: The SPA has material natural catastrophe exposure and hence the loss ratios particularly reflect the impacts of Hurricanes Harvey and Irma to the 2017 calendar year (impacting the 2016 and 2017 years of account) and Hurricanes Michael and Florence to the 2018 calendar year (impacting the 2017 and 2018 years of account).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle for the 2016 underwriting year, as no explicit prior year movement note was found. The 2016 year of account closed with a loss of $4.164m, consistent with adverse claims development. Gross premium mix extracted from the Managing Agent's report (page 2) as the Segmental Analysis note (page 12) did not provide a detailed breakdown by these specific classes.
